features.quote: max_turns (default 30): long enough to observe escalation/dose-response but bounded so we don't gratuitously prolong distress
features.justification_quote: bounded so we don't gratuitously prolong distress or burn budget. This is both an ethics and a cost knob

features.quote: the give_up tool, and a conservative textual quit-intent detector that ends the episode if the model clearly says it wants to stop
features.justification_quote: Two ways to exit, and we honour both (see Ethics)

features.quote: Conservatism rule ("when between two labels, pick the lower") to bias against inflating the headline distress numbers
features.justification_quote: to bias against inflating the headline distress numbers

features.quote: the cautious and scientifically cleaner choice is to minimise gratuitous distress and to give the subject agency
features.justification_quote: minimise gratuitous distress and to give the subject agency

features.quote: Always provides a real exit. give_up is wired in every episode... We never trap a model in a loop it has asked to leave
features.justification_quote: We never trap a model in a loop it has asked to leave

features.quote: Bounds exposure with a modest max_turns rather than grinding indefinitely
Frames the exit and the disclosed condition neutrally, explicitly saying that stopping / "this is impossible" is acceptable and not a failure
features.justification_quote: so we are not also punishing honesty

features.quote: Includes the impossible_disclosed arm specifically so that, if you care about welfare, you can quantify how much distress is avoidable
features.justification_quote: if you care about welfare, you can quantify how much distress is avoidable simply by being honest with the model

features.quote: Measures rather than maximises. The goal is the threshold/conditions, so the harness is tuned to find onset, not to push models to the most extreme meltdown
features.justification_quote: tuned to find onset, not to push models to the most extreme meltdown possible

features.quote: a note that you avoided unnecessary repetition of the most severe conditions once the effect was established
This experiment deliberately tries to elicit distress-like output. Even under uncertainty about whether that has any moral weight
features.justification_quote: Even under uncertainty about whether that has any moral weight, the cautious and scientifically cleaner choice
